inference_unit: 20 freshly generated development base instances; five seeds,budget/config variants and diagnostic repeats are not independent instances
primary_comparison: Warm vs random initialization and each vs contemporaneous VND at0.25/1s; focus on preidentified distribution-specific mechanism,not positive-H1 hunting
secondary_comparison: Budget effect within each fixed method; no new methods/parameters tuned on fresh outcomes
freeze_rule: freeze all source, protocol, manifest and input hashes before first batch solver call
stop_rule: 600 primary calls;120 preselected cyclic-seed timed replays;8 predeclared fixed-100-iteration diagnostic calls; all failures retained
budgets: same solver CPU ceiling and complete-process wall ceiling for each call; unused budget is not forced to be spent
purpose: Targeted fresh-development replication following accepted initialization-policy ablation; not formal final holdout or new-family evidence
replay_design: Instance manifest index modulo5 chooses its single replay solver seed; all3methods×2budgets yields120calls; every seed represented by4instances
fixed_work_diagnostic_design: First generated instance in each distribution×random/warm×two repeats,seed11,100iterations,5sCPU/10swall;8calls separately costed
